ap-csp.name: AP Computer Science Principles
ap-csp.calculator: Not permitted. Exam Reference Sheet provided.
ap-csp.note: Part of your score comes from the Create performance task, built in class over ~9 hours and submitted to the AP Digital Portfolio (due Fri, Apr 30, 2027). Only the end-of-course exam can be practised here.

sections.label: Section I: End-of-Course Multiple Choice
sections.note: 57 single-select, 5 single-select with a reading passage, 8 multiple-select (choose 2). Four answer options.

sections.label: Section II: Create Performance Task
sections.note: Two written-response questions (four prompts) about your own Personalized Project Reference, plus the through-course program and video.

ap-studio-art-2d.name: AP 2-D Art and Design
ap-studio-art-2d.reason: Portfolio only. You submit a body of work (Selected Works and Sustained Investigation) through the AP Digital Portfolio. There is no written exam to practise.

ap-studio-art-drawing.name: AP Drawing
ap-studio-art-drawing.reason: Portfolio only. You submit a body of work (Selected Works and Sustained Investigation) through the AP Digital Portfolio. There is no written exam to practise.

ap-seminar.name: AP Seminar
ap-seminar.reason: Mostly performance tasks: a Team Project and an Individual Research-Based Essay and Presentation, plus a written end-of-course exam. The performance tasks cannot be simulated here.

ap-research.name: AP Research
ap-research.reason: Performance task only: an academic paper, presentation and oral defence. There is no written end-of-course exam.
